create_model_debug_trace: create a model debug trace by wrapping a model with model_addition_debugger_context to log all forward pass inputs and outputs
run_model_forward_debug: run a model forward pass with model_addition_debugger_context to capture and serialize tensor inputs and outputs as JSON
summarize_model_call_tree: summarize a model call tree by generating a summary JSON file with tensor values stripped for readability
review_model_debug_tree: review a model debug tree by pruning intermediate layers and removing empty nodes from the call tree JSON
build_tensor_json_serialization: build JSON-serializable representations of torch Tensors and DTensors with shape, dtype, and statistics metadata
